name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Cody, Esther, and Wade go with Birchpool, Stillwater, and Willowmere, in some order.

Either Cody goes with Trout, or Bluegill goes with Stillwater — but not both.
Cody goes with none of Bluegill, Carp, or Pinehollow.
Cody goes with Willowmere if and only if Pinehollow does not go with Bluegill.
